% Fixture: pgfplots
%
% Purpose: verify that inline TikZ/PGFPlots does not cause false reruns.
%
% Expected maketex behaviour:
%   - Engine: pdflatex
%   - Passes: 1 (no bibliography, no cross-references, no ToC)
%   - Aux tools: none
%   - Output: main.pdf
%
% TikZ/PGFPlots computation happens entirely within the latex run; no auxiliary
% files are generated that would trigger a second pass.  A naive build tool
% that reruns whenever any file changes could be fooled by intermediate temp
% files written and deleted within a single run.

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

\title{PGFPlots Test}
\author{Test Fixture}
\date{2026-06-07}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\section{Inline plot}

The following plot is computed entirely within a single \LaTeX{} run and should
not trigger any additional passes.

\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  title={$f(x) = x^2$},
  xlabel={$x$},
  ylabel={$f(x)$},
  width=8cm,
  height=6cm,
]
\addplot[blue, thick, domain=-3:3, samples=60] {x^2};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}

\end{document}
